copy.headline: POP GOES THE WASABI
copy.dek: @PopPop4126 rode Josh Allen's five-touchdown stadium opener to the week's top score and flattened @Wasabi209.
copy.story_title: PopPop4126 Pops Off, EaglesRx Gets Sacked by Its Own Backup, and Herbert's Hermanos Win Family Night
story: Josh Allen opened Buffalo's new stadium by accounting for five touchdowns, and @PopPop4126 threw the housewarming party on @Wasabi209's lawn. The scarier part was who never got invited inside: Jared Goff threw four touchdowns from the bench, which is either depth or a hostage situation. One Sunday turned fourth place into first.

Goff wasn't the only quarterback with 327 yards and four touchdowns stuck in a fantasy waiting room. Matthew Stafford matched him yard for yard and score for score from @EaglesRx's bench while Lamar Jackson (15.8) started, and Stafford spent Monday night feeding Davante Adams, who was busy beating @EaglesRx for @sedwards1495. That's not losing to an opponent. That's the backup forwarding the mail. Elsewhere, the eldeib bowl went to @alexeldeib, as Jaxon Smith-Njigba's three scores outran @nseldeib and kept the bragging rights in the family name. And @TurkeyTime1 pushed every right lineup button and lost anyway, proof that good decisions need good players to decide on.
Two weeks in, five teams are unbeaten and the penthouse already needs a waiting list. Eleven teams now take aim at @PopPop4126, and the scouting report is short: pray that bench stays on the bench.

power_lines.line: Josh Allen christened a new stadium. This roster christened first place.
Benched Tre Tucker (22.9) torched Herbert's Chargers. With hermanos like these...
Started Dak (29.76) over Mahomes (28.98) and guessed right by 0.78. Sharp, if sweaty.
Two top-five scores, zero wins. Keep scoring like this and the wins have to show.
Brock Purdy (28.48) even ran one in himself. Purdy good case for a contender.
Undefeated and sliding anyway. Justin Jefferson (8.5) needs to RSVP to DeVonta Smith's party.
Trey McBride (18.1) and Will Reichard (12.3) kept it respectable. Bijan owes a rebound.
Omarion Hampton (17.5) scored and fumbled, the whole season so far in one afternoon.
Two losses in September. Nobody told TurkeyTime1 carving season is November.
Matt Gay hit a career-long 59-yarder. The schedule (349.12 against) kicked back harder.
CMC needed 23 rushing yards for two scores. A 1-1 record built on very short trips.
Tetairoa McMillan (15.1) and Tee Higgins (14.5) held up their end. Help is on backorder.

award_lines.line: Cameron Dicker scored 2.0 and it still wasn't remotely close.
Amon-Ra St. Brown (35.2) would have been the headliner almost anywhere else.
Two other teams' benches outscored this lineup. The couch is setting the bar.
The tightest game of the week, and Rachaad White (14.3) still napped through it.
Pushed every right button. None of them were connected to anything.
Jalen Coker (14.6) sat again, too. "Never gonna bench Coker" aged one week.
Stefon Diggs (21.7) caught two touchdowns. Nice digs, shame about the view.
Three touchdowns, one handed to the fans. Even the crowd got a cut.
Four touchdown passes, and the reward was a front-row seat to Allen.
195 yards and two scores. Monday night became Davante's Inferno.
Saquon gained nine rushing yards, roughly one good stride for him.
Seven teams scored more. None of them were on the schedule.
CeeDee Lamb (35.3) did everything except pick the opponent.

game_lines.line: Waiver pickup Konata Mumpfield earned a start and caught one pass for it.
Fans debate whether Shough crossed the goal line. He never crossed into the lineup.
Rice's late incompletion forced overtime, and Butker (17.5) cashed it for the opponent.
The Rams posted "Ate the W." @sedwards1495 got the leftovers.
New England's defense (28.0) more than tripled its projection. Allen had backup.
Hurts led a game-winning drive with 14 seconds left. Wrong game, @nseldeib.

copy.news:
Here are 8 on-field moments from Week 2 involving your league's players. Each one comes from the NFL, a team site or ESPN/Yahoo.

- **Matt Gay (You'll Never CMC Me Again):** He made a 59-yard field goal, the longest of his career, in the Raiders' 26-14 upset of the Chargers. A kicker setting a career long gets a lot of attention, and the Raiders' highlight page made a big deal of it. https://www.raiders.com/video/highlights-kirk-cousins-best-throws-nfl-week-2-chargers-2026-season

- **Ashton Jeanty, Tre Tucker and Justin Herbert (all Herbert's Hermanos):** Jeanty threw a pass on a trick play and found Dareke Young wide open. He also scored two touchdowns, and Tucker had 119 receiving yards. Meanwhile, Hezekiah Masses intercepted Herbert twice. That's an awkward split for one fantasy team: two of its players had big games against its own quarterback. https://www.raiders.com/video/highlights-kirk-cousins-best-throws-nfl-week-2-chargers-2026-season

- **Jaxon Smith-Njigba (Herbert's Hermanos):** After scoring against Arizona, he handed the ball to fans in the stands and jumped back onto the field. The NFL put the photo in its Top 10 of the week, and Seattle won 31-7, then trolled the Cardinals online. https://www.nfl.com/photos/top-10-photos-from-week-2-of-the-2026-season

- **Davante Adams (sedwards1495) and Matthew Stafford (EaglesRx):** On Monday night against the Giants, Adams had 195 yards and 2 touchdowns, and Stafford threw 4 touchdowns. The Rams then teased the Giants on social media with an "Ate the W" post, which topped ESPN's list of the week's best trolls. https://www.nfl.com/videos/top-plays-week-2-x1597

- **Harrison Butker, Patrick Mahomes (Never Gonna Gibbs You Up), Kenneth Walker (sedwards1495) and Rashee Rice (The (P)Rice is Right):** The Chiefs thought they had beaten the Colts on a strange ending, but the game went to overtime. Butker won it 33-30 with a 40-yard kick. Walker had 117 rushing yards plus 61 receiving yards. Late in regulation, a third-down pass to Rice was broken up, which killed the Chiefs' best chance to win before overtime. https://www.espn.com/nfl/scoreboard/_/week/2/year/2026/seasontype/2

- **Tyler Shough (Won't Rock), Chris Olave (Herbert's Hermanos) and Lamar Jackson (EaglesRx):** The Saints came back from 14-3 down to win 24-17 in Baltimore. Twice in a row Shough disappeared into a pile at the goal line, and fans are still arguing whether he crossed on fourth down. Jackson threw an interception with 13 seconds left to end it. Afterward, the Saints answered a trash-talking Ravens fan by posting video of Olave celebrating his touchdown. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49993163/nfl-week-2-2026-trolls

- **Josh Allen, Dalton Kincaid (PopPop4126) and James Cook (👩‍🍳 Cook coop conk):** The Bills opened their new stadium by beating Detroit 41-31, which meant a loss for Jahmyr Gibbs's team. Allen accounted for 5 touchdowns, Cook ran for 135 yards and a touchdown, and Kincaid had 95 yards and a touchdown. https://sports.yahoo.com/articles/7-biggest-takeaways-week-2-110000951.html

- **Jalen Hurts (👩‍🍳 Cook coop conk):** He threw 2 interceptions, including one into the end zone on the opening drive. That was his first interception on an end-zone throw since 2024. He then led a calm last drive and threw the winning touchdown to Darius Cooper with 14 seconds left. https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49951393/week-2-sunday-games-takeaways-questions-2026

**Caveats:**
- I ran out of searches before I could check every detail against a second source.
- On Allen, a Wikipedia entry says he had 4 touchdowns in a game. That may refer to a different week, so I went with Yahoo's count of 5.
- As you asked, I left out the week's injuries, including Caleb Williams, Jayden Daniels and Jayden Reed. I also skipped stories from less established sites, like a viral video of Kenneth Walker on the bench and a story about Cowboys fans reacting to CeeDee Lamb.
